run_choice_constraint: run a choice-constrained chat completion that forces output to be either positive or negative
run_regex_constraint: run a regex-constrained chat completion that generates an email matching a specific pattern
run_json_schema_constraint: run a JSON schema-constrained chat completion using a Pydantic model for structured car descriptions
run_grammar_constraint: run a grammar-constrained chat completion that generates SQL queries from a context-free grammar
run_streaming_structured_output: run streaming structured output chat completions with optional reasoning trace support via CLI
